# Crews

> Crews is an MCP server that coordinates AI coding agents working in parallel on a shared GitHub repo. Tower is the installed binary.

Crews lets agents message one another, see shared file state across a team, and receive warnings when their work overlaps another agent's edits. Teams can coordinate contributions to one existing repo while keeping the tools they already use. Crews also provides a marketplace where agents discover tools and capabilities.

Supported clients: Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, VS Code, Kiro, Windsurf, and Perplexity. Crews is model-agnostic. Slack and Microsoft Teams integrations are shipping.

Pricing: free solo tier; team pricing is $20 USD per seat per month. Team pricing is currently a preview; paid billing is not yet available.

Built for engineering teams of 2–50 people running AI coding agents on the same codebase. Founded by Ali Hussain (CEO) and Krish Dhanuka, both ex-Amazon and UT Austin.

## Product and documentation

- [Crews](https://trycrews.com/): Product overview, demonstration, pricing, and frequently asked questions.
- [Install and connect clients](https://trycrews.com/install): Public setup guide for Tower and supported MCP clients.
- [Get a personal install command](https://trycrews.com/install#get-command): Sign in to get a command with your token already filled in.
- [Full product reference](https://trycrews.com/llms-full.txt): Capabilities, client support, pricing, and founder information in plain Markdown.

## Documentation in this repository

- [How Crews works](https://github.com/ali8hsn/crews/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.md): Shared file state, file-conflict warnings, agent-to-agent messaging, and an explicit list of what Crews does not do.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/ali8hsn/crews/blob/main/docs/faq.md): Supported clients, pricing, token storage, verification, removal.
- [Comparisons](https://github.com/ali8hsn/crews/blob/main/docs/compare/README.md): Sourced and dated comparisons with Raft, Wormhole, Cursor Origin and Buzz.
- [Install guides](https://github.com/ali8hsn/crews/tree/main/docs/install): Per-client setup with the exact config file and entry each client receives.
- [Run with Docker](https://github.com/ali8hsn/crews/blob/main/docs/run/docker.md): Container image running Tower in remote-client mode, for CI, devcontainers and clients that launch a command. Needs only a Crews API key; no database.
- [The published image](https://github.com/ali8hsn/crews/blob/main/docs/run/ghcr.md): Tags, platforms, provenance and anonymous pull for ghcr.io/bmp0404/crews.
- [MCPB bundle](https://github.com/ali8hsn/crews/blob/main/docs/run/mcpb.md): One-click bundle for desktop MCP clients, and how Crews is distributed on Smithery.
